newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australand Holdings buys Sydney site.
newsitem.headline: Australand Holdings buys Sydney site.

text.p: Property developer Australand Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had arranged to acquire a 4.9 hectare site at Villawood in Sydney's west from the Australian Government.
When fully developed Australand said the site would be worth in excess of A$22 million.
Stage one of the development was pre-leased with a BBC Hardware's "Hardwarehouse" expected to open in the second quarter of 1998, Australand said.
Australand is about 63.4 percent owned by Singapore-based property and hotel group DBS Land and listed on the Australian Stock Exchange on June 16, 1997.
By 3.40 p.m. (0540 GMT), Australand shares were two cents higher at A$1.62.
